schema.name: ganglior.node-export
schema.doc: ECGDex beat-derived events → Ganglior bus. tMs = floating wall-clock ms (UTC getters). null = unknown, never fabricated.

timing.reason: host ≡ device — residual spread 1.00 ms ≤ 2 ms (one stamp quantum); this host column is not an independent clock; the rate correction did not reach the published rate: host column is not a second clock (residual spread 1.00 ms, within one stamp quantum — the host stamp is the device stamp rounded), fs left on the device clock

hostAxis.note: quote `ppm` WITH `ppmUncertainty`; `stability:null` means there was no second clock (host column ≡ device stamp), not that the clock was perfect

evidence.envelopeReason: no acquisition envelope joins the ECG path — the capture-host envelope keys on the O2Ring .dat session_id; the H10 stream carries none
